description: This file implements a handler for deep links specific to the OpenClaw application, including validation, delivery logic, and UI interactions. It contains enums and a class responsible for parsing, validating, and executing deep link commands, as well as generating and managing keys used in the process.

classes.name: DeepLinkHandler
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for handling incoming deep link URLs, validating, prompting the user, and executing associated actions within the application.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a URL deep link, parsing it and triggering corresponding actions based on the route.

methods.name: handleAgent
methods.description: Handles agent-specific deep links, performing validation, user confirmation, and dispatching the agent invocation.

methods.name: currentKey
methods.description: Retrieves the current expected security key for deep links.

methods.name: currentCanvasKey
methods.description: Returns the ephemeral key used for Canvas unattended deep links.

methods.name: expectedKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a persistent key stored in user defaults for deep link validation.

methods.name: generateRandomKey
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random key string used internally.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Displays a modal confirmation alert to the user and returns true if 'Run' is selected.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays an informational alert to the user.
